correctness.rationale: Fix sorted x and scale ε=1 so every adjacent input gap g_i∈[0,1]. For fixed contact pattern, each included/excluded condition is a signed consecutive-interval sum <=1 or >=1. Signed interval-incidence matrix is totally unimodular by alternating-column-sign criterion; integer right sides give only binary vertices. Updated mean gaps are linear within a cell. Upper bounding each contact cell by weakly admissible binary vertices is safe; actual two sharp examples attain the maxima. Independent exact rational enumeration reproduced all binary-vertex comparison totals (n2..6: 2,12,78,616,6150) and extrema 0,1/2,1,5/4,3/2, and re-evaluated n5=(0,1,2,3,3), n6=(0,0,1,2,3,3). Sorting is preserved by monotone contiguous neighborhoods. Finite certification is exhaustive only AFTER the structural integral-polytope lemma.
correctness.residual_risks: No extension of exact Δ_n table to n>6 or later time steps; numerical coarser mesh is not an infinite-variable proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Hegarty–Wedin restrict spacing and track later dynamics, while Li proves n<=4 nonfragmentation and a 5-agent counterexample. Their theorems are insufficient for the unrestricted n=5,6 sharp one-step maxima.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge: Li (2021) supplies the five-agent 5/4 gap example and preservation of connectivity for n<=4, which are not novel here. The submitted general fixed-contact cell binary extremum reduction plus exhaustive exact sharp upper bounds 5/4 for n=5 and 3/2 for n=6 are not implied by the prior local neighbor-overlap bounds or equally-spaced HK studies. Direct independent exact enumeration of all weak graph-pattern binary vertices and sharp witnesses corroborated the finite classification.
residual_risks: An unindexed polyhedral fixed-neighborhood reduction or larger all-size HK extremal census could cover this exact claim; negative search is not proof of novelty.
The five-agent 5/4 witness is prior and never asserted as a new counterexample.

value.rationale: Sharp first-step fragmentation severity is a natural invariant of connected bounded-confidence dynamics, not merely an existing five-agent counterexample. The first two vulnerable population sizes admit exact 25% and 50% maximal overshoot, and the general binary-contact reduction turns continuous extremal questions into finite exact combinatorial checks for future n.
value.residual_risks: Only the first synchronous update and inclusive homogeneous one-dimensional confidence averaging are considered.

limitations: Only n<=6 exact numeric values, one synchronous real-valued HK update; structural binary reduction for arbitrary n.
